answer: Nobody is waved through free: $7 per docket, and 95 dockets before the first reward is released is the price, and the spiral never covers it twice. The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. No Commonbound pigman hop patent, no seat: the rule is plain, and a patent pigmen file after pigsty audits is why it holds. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. Every voyage is counted once. crystal stays on the record.
